Bangalore

Professional Summary
Data engineering professional with a focus on designing and operating scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. Experienced in developing ETL/ELT workflows, optimizing SQL and Spark jobs for performance, and orchestrating data processes using Airflow and Databricks. Proven track record delivering reliable data products for logistics and enterprise use cases. Notice period: 60 days.

Technical Skills
Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, BigQuery, Databricks, Confluence

Work Experience

Senior Data Engineer, Bluefin Logistics (Aug 2024 - Present)
- Designed and implemented BigQuery data models and partitioning strategies to support nightly and near-real-time analytics, reducing query cost by 35% while improving report freshness; used SQL and BigQuery for analytics and data validation.
- Built Apache Airflow DAGs to orchestrate multi-stage ETL flows ingesting telematics and shipment events, improving pipeline reliability and enabling SLA-based retries.
- Developed PySpark jobs for batch enrichment and deduplication of shipment records running on managed Spark clusters, cutting end-to-end processing time by 40% and improving downstream data quality.

Big Data Engineer, Wipro (Jun 2018 - Jul 2024)
- Implemented Databricks-based ETL frameworks to process clickstream and transactional datasets, standardizing notebooks and CICD practices to accelerate onboarding and deployments.
- Developed and maintained Apache Airflow orchestration for cross-team pipelines, integrating with Databricks jobs and monitoring via Confluence-run playbooks to ensure operational runbooks and incident response.
- Tuned Spark jobs and SQL transformations to optimize resource utilization and reduce job runtimes by up to 50% on high-volume data workloads.

Education
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
